description: This file defines the 'Topic' controller class within the OpenCart admin module, specifically for handling event-driven task scheduling related to CMS topics. It includes methods to add, edit, and delete topics by queuing corresponding tasks.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller class handling event hooks for CMS topic operations and scheduling corresponding tasks.

methods.name: addTopic
methods.description: Handles event to add a new topic by scheduling a 'create' task.

methods.name: editTopic
methods.description: Handles event to edit an existing topic by scheduling an 'update' task.

methods.name: deleteTopic
methods.description: Handles event to delete a topic by scheduling a 'delete' task.
